learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will revise A and An, and learn to use the special pointing word 'The' for specific and unique things.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 In Class 1, we met two best friends, 'A' and 'An'. But guess what? A new king has arrived in the grammar family, and his name is 'The'! Let's meet the three Articles!

lesson_modules.module_title: 🌟 Quick Review: A and An (एक का अर्थ)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: We use 'A' before words starting with consonant sounds. We use 'An' before words starting with vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u). Both mean ONE thing.
We use the word 'The' when we talk about a SPECIFIC or particular thing. We also use 'The' when we talk about the same thing again.
examples_or_templates: I saw a cat. The cat was sleeping. 🐈

lesson_modules.module_title: 🌍 One of a Kind! (दुनिया में अकेली चीजें)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: King 'The' is very special! We ALWAYS use 'The' before things that are only ONE in the whole universe.
Remember, we never use A, An, or The before people's special names (Proper Nouns). You cannot say 'A Rahul' or 'The Priya'.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What will you use before the word 'Moon'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Fill in the blank: Look at ____ stars in ____ sky.
subjective_practice.hint: The sky is the only one in the world! (the / the)

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Choose A or An: I eat ____ orange every day.
subjective_practice.hint: Orange starts with an 'o', which is a vowel!

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Find the mistake: 'I met the Amit yesterday.'
subjective_practice.hint: Do we use 'The' before special names of people?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎨 The 'A, An, The' Detective
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Take an English newspaper or storybook. Find and circle 'A' with a red crayon, 'An' with blue, and 'The' with green! Find 5 of each.

chapter_summary: ⭐ We use 'A' for consonant sounds and 'An' for vowel sounds.
⭐ We use 'The' for specific things or things mentioned again.
⭐ We ALWAYS use 'The' for unique things like The Sun, The Moon, and The Earth.
